evidence_items.explanation: Across 11 task families, the study found poorer performance under changed conditions, but also above-random performance on most variants and some transferable reasoning. It supports brittle pattern dependence without establishing how much everyday generative-AI behavior is mimicry; the retrieved record does not date testing within the target quarter.
